title: Pick the breakpoint for the bug
purpose: Connect each kind of bug to the breakpoint type that catches it, and recall what to read when the page pauses.
sequence_reason: The summary walks the debugging loop in order: choose a breakpoint, pause, read Scope and the Call Stack, then fix the code.
summary: Use a line-of-code breakpoint when you know the line, a conditional breakpoint when only some calls are wrong, and a logpoint when you must not pause. When you do not know the line, break on the cause: an XHR or fetch request, a DOM change, an event listener or an exception. At the pause read Scope and the Call Stack; async frames show who started the wait and the ignore list hides library frames. The search race is fixed by returning early when q !== input.value.
explanation: Each breakpoint type answers a different question. Choose the one that pauses closest to the cause, then read the state at that moment.

learning_check.question: A list on the page changes and you do not know which script changes it. Which breakpoint do you set?
learning_check.answer: A DOM change breakpoint (subtree modifications) on the list element. It pauses on the code that changes the list.

scenes.heading: Pick the breakpoint for the bug
When you know the line
scenes.narration: Know the line? Use a line-of-code breakpoint. Only some calls are wrong? Use a conditional breakpoint. Must not pause? Use a logpoint.

scenes.heading: When you do not know the line
scenes.narration: When you do not know the line, break on the cause: a fetch request, a DOM change, an event listener, or an exception.

items: A changed node: DOM change breakpoint
A click or key: event listener breakpoint

scenes.heading: Read the pause
scenes.narration: At the pause, read Scope for the values and the Call Stack for the callers. Async frames show who started the wait. The ignore list hides library frames.

items: Async frames: who started the wait

scenes.heading: Fix the race
scenes.narration: The bug: render used a stale response. The fix on line 6: return when q !== input.value.
